description: This file defines the class VTCreateTodoTask, which extends VTTask to implement a specific task related to creating calendar to-do items based on entity data. It contains methods for executing the task, managing user context, and handling date/time processing within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: VTCreateTodoTask
classes.description: A class that creates calendar to-do tasks based on provided entity data within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns the list of fields relevant for the task, including 'todo', 'description', 'sendNotification', 'time', 'date', 'status', 'priority', 'days', 'direction', 'datefield'.

methods.name: getAdmin
methods.description: Sets the current user to the active admin user and preserves the original user context.

methods.name: doTask
methods.description: Performs the task logic to create a calendar activity (task) based on entity data, handling date calculations, setting activity fields, and linking to related entities.

methods.name: conv12to24hour
methods.description: Converts a 12-hour time string (e.g., '1:30pm') to 24-hour format.

methods.name: getTimeFieldList
methods.description: Returns an array containing 'time' indicating the time-related fields.
